chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Mūsā ibn ʿUmar, from Muʿammar ibn Khallād, who said:

Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام sent for me regarding a need, so I entered upon him. He said: 'Return, and when it is tomorrow, then come; and do not come except after sunrise, for I sleep when I have performed the fajr prayer.'

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّل: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the speaker in the report
key_terms.أَنَامُ: I sleep; indicating the Imam’s practice after fajr
key_terms.انْصَرِفْ: go back or depart; the instruction given to the narrator
key_terms.صَلَّيْتُ الْفَجْرَ: I have performed the fajr prayer; the act after which the sleep occurred
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ: sunrise; the time after which the narrator was told to come

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام say about sleeping after salat al-fajr?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام instructed the narrator to visit only after sunrise because he would sleep after performing salat al-fajr. It appears in a chapter on the reprehensibility of sleeping after the morning prayer, indicating a contextual legal and devotional discussion around post-fajr sleep.
